title: Shabari Never Tasted the Berries
source: Valmiki Ramayana, Aranya Kanda 3(69-70) (Critical Edition; vulgate 3.73-74)

captions.instagram:
Did Shabari really taste the berries before giving them to Rama?

Everyone knows Shabari tasted each ber before giving it to Rama. Valmiki's Ramayana says something simpler: she gathered forest fruit from the banks of the Pampa, for the guest her teachers told her would come. The tasted-berry story is a beautiful later bhakti tradition — just not Valmiki's.

📜 Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Aranya Kanda 3(69-70) (Critical Edition; vulgate 3.73-74)

captions.youtube_description:
Did Shabari really taste the berries before giving them to Rama?

Everyone knows Shabari tasted each ber before giving it to Rama. Valmiki's Ramayana says something simpler: she gathered forest fruit from the banks of the Pampa, for the guest her teachers told her would come. The tasted-berry story is a beautiful later bhakti tradition — just not Valmiki's.

Source: Valmiki Ramayana, Aranya Kanda 3(69-70) (Critical Edition; vulgate 3.73-74)
Verses:
• Kabandha directs Rama west to Lake Pampa and Matanga's hermitage, where the ascetic Shabari lives — 3.69 (CE)
• On seeing the princes she rises with joined palms and clasps the feet of Rama and Lakshmana — 3.70.6 (CE)
• Rama asks whether her austerities are unhindered and her service to her teachers fruitful — 3.70 (CE)
• Her teachers told her to await Rama; she gathered forest produce from the banks of the Pampa for him — 3.70.10-13 (CE)
• Valmiki does not name berries (ber) and has no tasting; the tasted-fruit story appears in later devotional literature (17th-18th c. Vaishnava hagiography, e.g. Priyadas's Bhaktirasbodhini c.1712) — absent from Valmiki; also absent from Kamban, Adhyatma Ramayana and Ramcharitmanas
• She shows them the Matanga forest: the teachers' altar still glows, their bark garments are still wet, their flowers unwithered — 3.70 (CE)
• With Rama's leave she enters the fire and rises to the realm of her teachers — 3.70 (CE), end of chapter
